design_system.vibe: Optimistic, tactile, digital toy meets wellness tool.
design_system.rules: Pair soft pastels with heavy dark borders and hard solid shadows. This grounds the cute 3D claymorphism aesthetic and prevents the app from feeling overly childish. It looks like a premium, trendy App Store editor's choice app.

cards.base: bg-white border-4 border-[#18181B] rounded-3xl shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_#18181B] p-8 md:p-10

buttons.primary: bg-[#FDE047] text-[#18181B] border-4 border-[#18181B] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-fredoka font-bold text-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#18181B] hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0px_0px_0_0_#18181B] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#18181B] text-white border-4 border-[#18181B] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-fredoka font-bold text-xl hover:bg-white hover:text-[#18181B] transition-colors

tags.base: inline-block bg-[#FFB5A7] border-2 border-[#18181B] rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-dm-sans font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#18181B]

layout_protocol.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. px-6 or px-12 for containers.
layout_protocol.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.layout: Sticky, top-0, z-50. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFDF8]/90. border-b-4 border-[#18181B]. Flex space-between. Left: 'BlinkBear' logo + Bear icon. Right: Nav links and 'Get App' button.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.layout: Asymmetrical split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2). Left: Huge H1 'Your eyes deserve better.' + App Store Button. Right: A large 3D bear image floating over a pastel blob/shape background.

sections.name: Marquee (The Science)
sections.layout: Full width scrolling marquee (using react-fast-marquee). Text: '20 MINUTES • 20 SECONDS • 20 FEET • SCIENTIFICALLY PROVEN •'. Thick solid text. Bg: Mint #A1E3CB, border-y-4 border-[#18181B].

sections.name: Features Bento Grid
sections.layout: Container max-w-7xl. 4 Cards. Card 1 (span 8): Smart Monitoring (Mint Bg). Card 2 (span 4): Gentle Reminders (Peach Bg). Card 3 (span 4): Privacy First (Lavender Bg). Card 4 (span 8): Progress Tracking (Butter Bg). Put 3D Bear fallback images in these cards.

sections.name: How It Works
sections.layout: Vertical visual timeline. 6 Steps. Use large circular numbers with border-4. Connect them with a vertical dashed or solid line. Keep it playful.

sections.name: Pricing (Free vs Premium)
sections.layout: Two massive side-by-side cards. Left 'Free' (White bg, core features). Right 'Premium' (Butter bg, 10+ bear themes). Feature lists with Lucide icons (Check/X).

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.layout: Masonry or slider of smaller neo-brutalist cards. 5-star reviews about ending doomscrolling.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.layout: Deep padded section. Background Peach #FFB5A7. Border-y-4. Centered huge text 'Build lasting healthy habits.' App Store Download button.

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Dark theme shift: bg-[#18181B], text-[#FFFDF8]. Massive 'BlinkBear' at bottom. Links: Contact (blinkbear.app@gmail.com) and App Store Link.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The prompt mentions 'provided as image assets (bear in hot air balloon, bear DJ...)'. I checked the repo and they are NOT present yet. You MUST set up the UI using the 'bear_fallback' Unsplash images provided in the image_urls block as placeholders. Give them clear alt tags (e.g., 'bear DJ placeholder') so the user can easily replace the src later.
Build a pure HTML/Tailwind Marketing Page (do NOT use Shadcn Card/Button components as they are too rigid for this neo-brutalist style).
Setup the fonts: Add Google Fonts link to index.html and update tailwind.config.js to include fontFamilies 'fredoka' and 'dm-sans'.
Implement the Neo-brutalist style precisely: Every major card and button must have 'border-4 border-[#18181B]' and 'shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_#18181B]' (or similar offsets).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive buttons, links, and forms as required.
Ensure the App Store badge link points to: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/blinkbear/id6756180445
Use Lucide-react for icons (e.g., eye, shield, check, star, smartphone).
For the Marquee, install and use 'react-fast-marquee'.
